newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds at new highs, break 200 to Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds at new highs, break 200 to Bunds.

text.p: Spanish bonds countinued their fast run on Friday, accumulating yet another record high.
At 1007 GMT, the cash 10-year spread over German Bunds broke under the 200 resistance level reaching a minimum of 198, while the differential over Italian Btps stood at 87.
At the same time, the December 10-year bond future rose 73 basis points from Thursday's close at 105.20. Chartists put resistance at 105.25 and support at 105.00.
Dealers said the market is positive on the 1997 budget and an expected rate cut by Bank of Spain. But they do not rule out a possible consolidation before the week end.
